verdict.line: You lose if you drift inside Cryptic Gaze's 550 range and eat his Enrage all-in; you win if you poke from outside that range and punish every window his Q is down.

brief.thesis: Jayce is a ranged champion in Cannon stance fighting a melee champion whose only gap-closer is a single-target stun — Q (Cryptic Gaze), 550 range. Sion has no dash, no slow, no leap; if that stun is down he cannot reach you safely. The entire lane is decided by whether you respect that 550-range threat while poking, which lines up with the measured 46.7% win rate over 197 games on an otherwise even matchup with a solo-kill edge in your favor.

theirWindow.when: Sion lands Q (Cryptic Gaze) stun on you
theirWindow.what: He stuns you from 550 range then closes to melee with E (Enrage) toggled for bonus AD and W (Death's Caress) shield up — you cannot out-trade him point blank, so disengage or Flash immediately rather than fighting through it.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Cryptic Gaze) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and poke freely with Cannon-stance Q (Shock Blast) at max range, or swap to Hammer stance and use Q (To the Skies!) to leap in plus E (Thundering Blow) to knock him back and reset the trade before his stun returns.

start.why: 93.7% pick rate at 44.8% win rate over 223 games — the AD and sustain let you keep trading autos in Cannon stance without losing the poke war on mana.

boots.why: 51.7% win rate over 60 games — flat basic-attack reduction directly counters Sion's E (Enrage), which converts his health into extra damage on every auto he lands on you.

armor shred lets your poke keep scaling damage as he stacks health from Enrage kills

you're ahead on poke and want a dash reset to finish extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: 50% win rate over 20 games on this keystone — stacking Conqueror through ranged autos and Q pokes rewards the long, drawn-out trades this lane produces instead of a single all-in.

summoners.why: 78.5% pick rate at 41.8% win rate — Teleport lets you reset waves and hit item timings in a lane that's decided by patience rather than early kill pressure; Flash+Ignite (43.8% win rate, 20.7% pick) is the alternative if you want to force the solo-kill edge this matchup gives you.

playing.title: Poke only from Cannon stance
playing.detail: Use Cannon-stance Q (Shock Blast) at its full 600 range to chip Sion without ever entering his 550-range Q (Cryptic Gaze) threat — the lane is even, not yours to force.

playing.title: Respect the 550-range stun
playing.detail: Cryptic Gaze's range almost matches your own poke range; walking up to last-hit or auto while it's up risks eating a stun into his melee combo with E (Enrage) toggled on.

playing.title: Punish the cooldown window
playing.detail: His Q starts at 12s and drops to 8s at max rank — the moment it's down, step up aggressively or swap to Hammer stance for Q (To the Skies!) plus E (Thundering Blow) to knock him off you before it comes back.

playing.title: Shred his shield with Serpent's Fang
playing.detail: Serpent's Fang cuts shield effectiveness, so your poke damage isn't wasted absorbing into his W (Death's Caress) before it explodes or gets detonated early.

playing.title: Stay outside the shield pop
playing.detail: Death's Caress deals damage to everyone nearby when it expires or is reactivated — hold max range in Cannon stance so that burst never reaches you.

playing.title: Track his 90-second R timer
playing.detail: Cannibalism is only available every 90s — identify when it's down and force the longer skirmishes then, since he loses the attack-speed and healing spike that wins drawn-out fights.

playing.title: Fire Shock Blast through your own gate
playing.detail: Deploying E (Acceleration Gate) and firing Cannon-stance Q (Shock Blast) through it increases the missile's speed, range, and damage for a bigger poke before he can close in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are this brief's own tactical read, not OP.GG data.
